title: Entity Resolution Benchmark

same_name_entities.findings: GFIN merges people solely on normalized_person_name('John Smith') without verifying DOB, SSN, email, or geographical context.

shared_infrastructure.findings: Domain normalizer strips URLs but does not account for multi-tenant CDN/CloudFront infrastructure sharing.

aliases.findings: Cross-platform entities with different entity_type labels (TELEGRAM_IDENTIFIER vs SOCIAL_ACCOUNT) are treated as non-matching by type guard, failing to detect true aliases unless explicitly linked.

recycled_usernames.findings: No temporal or platform-isolation checks exist; identical username handles on different platforms/times are treated as exact matches.

unrelated_wallets.findings: Crypto addresses are matched by exact address string; single-transaction relationships do not trigger auto-merge in match_entities, but lack co-spending/cluster validation.

architectural_gaps_identified: PostgreSQL indexed lookups for normalized_value NOT implemented (currently in-memory scan)
Fuzzy matching / ML-based name similarity NOT implemented
Multi-attribute entity disambiguation (DOB, national ID, temporal range) missing
Infrastructure co-tenancy (CDN / shared hosting IP) awareness missing
Distributed merge locking and event bus integration missing
